body.name: assertionSlacksZero
body.def: For \(\psi(p)=\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}p+\beta_{\psi}\), set \(g_{0,\psi}(u)=+\infty\) if \(\psi(p_0)>0\), \(g_{0,\psi}(u)=-\infty\) if \(\psi(p_0)<0\), and \(g_{0,\psi}(u)=\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}Bu\) if \(\psi(p_0)=0\). A zero last expression is a fixed tie assigned to every incident completion.
body.role: sample-size-free tangent encoding without evaluating an unlawful affine probability vector
